name: ES Morning-to-Lunch Anchor Transfer v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit
origin: Priority 2 was sealed in es_candidate_macro_synthesis_v1.md before the closing-response results were observed.
hypothesis: A closing-session edge may exist when lunch accepts a new value center relative to the entire morning auction. The lunch participant group must transfer both volume-weighted value and its terminal price across the morning center; failure back through lunch value structurally invalidates the transfer.

signal.auction_center: volume-weighted mean of one-minute typical price (high + low + close) / 3
signal.long_signal: lunch center and 13:29 close are both strictly above the morning center
signal.short_signal: lunch center and 13:29 close are both strictly below the morning center
signal.zero_rule: no trade when lunch center and terminal close do not agree relative to the morning center

execution.entry: 13:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.long_stop_trigger: one ES tick below the lunch center
execution.short_stop_trigger: one ES tick above the lunch center
execution.stop_fill: the trigger price unless the stop bar opens beyond it, then the worse bar open plus one adverse tick
execution.entry_validity: skip if the stop is not adverse to entry
execution.same_bar_rule: if the 13:30 entry bar touches the stop trigger, assume the stop fills
execution.survivor_exit: 15:55 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

decision: Reject. Development passed narrowly, but holdout missed frequency, year, side, tail, and bootstrap robustness requirements.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was evaluated only after all initial development gates passed.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: using close, median, POC, or another center definition
adding center-distance, volatility, volume, side, weekday, or regime filters
changing the stop reference or exit time
selecting years or directions after results
